trip.title: London, Paris & Buxton
trip.subtitle: A week away for the wedding

segments.title: Fly to London
segments.info: Ref EAU2YY, carry-on only
segments.detail: Virgin Atlantic VS20, a direct overnight flight to Heathrow that takes about 10 hours and 20 minutes in economy. You have one carry-on up to 10kg plus a personal item, and no checked bags.

segments.title: Land at Heathrow
segments.info: Elizabeth line into town · UK ETA needed
segments.detail: Clear passport control, then take the Piccadilly line direct from Heathrow to King's Cross St Pancras, about 50 to 60 minutes and around 6 pounds. It runs from the terminal with no changes, and your hotel is a few minutes from there. Tap in with your contactless card, no Oyster needed. As an Australian passport holder you must have an approved UK ETA before boarding at SFO (about 16 pounds, linked to your passport, valid two years) and airlines verify it at check in. With it approved you can use the e-gates at Heathrow.

segments.title: Check in to the hotel
segments.info: Ref 6024.959.454, 100 pound deposit

commute.summary: Piccadilly line from Heathrow to King's Cross St Pancras, about 55 minutes, then a 5 minute walk

segments.detail: Four Points Flex by Sheraton on Upper Woburn Place. It is a windowless double pod, very dark and good for jet lagged sleep. No breakfast is included, and they take a 100 pound damage deposit on arrival that is refunded within a week. Check out is Wednesday by noon.

pin.name: Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
pin.address: 8-11 Upper Woburn Place, London WC1H 0JV, UK

segments.title: Wander Notting Hill
segments.info: The market winds down around 5pm

commute.summary: Central line from Tottenham Court Road to Notting Hill Gate, about 20 minutes door to door

segments.detail: From the hotel, walk to Tottenham Court Road and take the Central line west to Notting Hill Gate, about 20 minutes door to door. The Portobello Road antiques market winds down around 5pm, so head there first. There are pastel terraces on Lansdowne Road, the Electric Cinema, and good independent coffee. An easy way to decompress after the flight.

segments.title: Dinner at Fallow
segments.info: Booked for 7:30pm
segments.detail: One of the best places in London right now, with nose to tail British cooking and excellent cocktails. It is about 20 minutes from Notting Hill Gate by Tube. Save your appetite, and budget around 80 to 100 pounds with drinks.

pin.name: Fallow St James's
pin.address: 2 St James's Market, London SW1Y 4AH, UK

days.label: Coworking day and beers with a friend

segments.title: Breakfast at Pophams Islington
segments.info: Best pastries in London to start the day

commute.summary: Northern line to Angel, then about a 10 minute walk, around 20 minutes total

segments.detail: Start the day at the original Pophams on Prebend Street in Islington. Laminated pastries done as well as anywhere in the city, plus a seasonal lunch menu if you want something more substantial. The pain au chocolat is the classic, but the honey and smoked salt bun is the one to get. Nearest tube is Angel, about a 10 minute walk; Essex Road overground is closer if it suits. Have a coffee and take your time before a wander.

segments.title: Wander around Islington
segments.info: Stretch your legs before coworking
segments.detail: Walk off breakfast around Islington. Upper Street and Camden Passage are full of antiques shops, independents and quiet Georgian terraces. An easy, low-key stroll before you head back to collect your laptop.

segments.title: Back to the hotel for your laptop
segments.info: Quick stop, then on to the library

commute.summary: Northern line from Angel to Euston, about 5 minutes plus walking, 15 minutes total

segments.detail: Commute back to the Four Points on Upper Woburn Place, grab your laptop and anything you need for a few hours of work, then walk over to the British Library. It is only a few minutes away on foot.

pin.name: Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
pin.address: 8-11 Upper Woburn Place, London WC1H 0JV, UK

segments.title: Coworking at the British Library
segments.info: Two to three hours of focused work

commute.summary: About a 7 minute walk from the hotel

segments.detail: A few hours of remote work in one of the best free spaces in London. There is fast wifi, plenty of desks and power in the public areas, and a cafe for a coffee top-up. You do not need a Reader Pass for the open seating areas. Settle in for two to three hours of focused work.

segments.title: Late lunch: fish and chips or Straker's
segments.info: Two options depending on how far you want to go

commute.summary: Hammersmith & City line from King's Cross to Westbourne Park, then a 10 minute walk, about 30 minutes total

segments.detail: For something quick and close, the North Sea Fish Restaurant on Leigh Street is a classic chippy a few minutes' walk from the library. If you would rather make the trip, Straker's on Golborne Road in Notting Hill does Thomas Straker's produce-led modern British small plates: take the Hammersmith & City line direct to Westbourne Park, then a 10 minute walk, about 30 minutes total. Check it is open for midweek lunch before you set off.

segments.title: Beers with a friend
segments.info: Around 5pm · home by 8pm
segments.detail: Meet your friend for a few beers around 5pm. Keep it relaxed and leave enough time to get back, since you want to be at the hotel by 8pm. Confirm the spot with them, then head back to Bloomsbury after.

segments.title: Back at the hotel by 8pm
segments.info: Early night
segments.detail: Aim to be back at the Four Points by 8pm for an early, easy night.

pin.name: Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
pin.address: 8-11 Upper Woburn Place, London WC1H 0JV, UK

days.label: A slow morning, then the train to Paris

segments.title: Collect bags and walk to St Pancras
segments.info: Check out by noon
segments.detail: Back to the hotel to check out by noon, then a ten minute walk to St Pancras. Grab lunch at the station before you clear Eurostar security. No rush, you have time built in.

segments.title: Eurostar to Paris
segments.info: Coach 16, seat 48, ref C64F2Q
segments.detail: About two and a half hours direct to Gare du Nord. Arrive at St Pancras 75 to 90 minutes early for security and border control; as an Australian (non-EU) passport holder, the first EU entry under the new EES may require registering fingerprints and a photo, so allow extra time. Gates close 30 minutes before departure. Complete your advance passenger information beforehand, since you need it to collect the tickets.

segments.title: Check in to the hotel

commute.summary: An 8 minute walk from Gare du Nord

segments.detail: Hotel d'Amiens on Rue des Deux Gares, an eight minute walk from Gare du Nord. It is a quiet twin room on the ground floor with air conditioning and good soundproofing. No breakfast, around 423 dollars including city tax, paid at the property. Check out is Friday by noon.

pin.name: Hotel d'Amiens
pin.address: 11 Rue des Deux Gares, 75010 Paris, France

segments.title: First evening in Paris
segments.info: Wine and small plates
segments.detail: Drop your bags and explore. If you still have energy, the Louvre stays open late on Wednesdays until 9:45pm. Otherwise head to Canal Saint Martin, about 15 minutes on foot, for natural wine and small plates.

segments.title: Breakfast at the bakery
segments.info: Order at the counter like a local
segments.detail: Find a neighbourhood boulangerie near the hotel. A cafe au lait and a pain au chocolat, taken standing at the bar like a local.

segments.title: The Louvre
segments.info: Book a 9 to 10am slot, about 32 euros
segments.detail: Closed on Tuesdays, but you are visiting on Thursday so you are fine. A timed reservation is mandatory in July, so book a 9am slot in advance and head straight to the Mona Lisa before the groups arrive. The Venus de Milo and the Winged Victory are nearby. Non-EU adult entry is 32 euros. Aim to wrap up by noon so you make the lunch window at Dents de Loup, which stops serving cuisine at 14h30.

segments.title: Lunch at Dents de Loup
segments.info: Cuisine served 12h to 14h30, Tue to Sat

commute.summary: Metro 7 from Palais Royal to Cadet, about 15 minutes

segments.detail: A boucherie-charcuterie-comptoir in the 9th doing exceptional meat and charcuterie with a serious wine list. The boudin noir and the terrines come highly praised. Cuisine is only served 12h to 14h30, Tuesday to Saturday, so arrive by around 12:30 to be safe; it gets busy and does not take long lunches. From the Louvre take metro line 7 from Palais Royal to Cadet, then a short walk. Budget around 30 to 45 euros with a glass of wine.

pin.name: Dents de Loup
pin.address: 75 Rue Marguerite de Rochechouart, 75009 Paris, France

segments.title: Le Marais and Notre Dame
segments.info: Reserve a free Notre Dame slot

commute.summary: Metro south from the 9th to the Marais, about 20 minutes

segments.detail: After lunch, head south to the Marais, with its galleries and the falafel spots on Rue des Rosiers, then over to the Ile de la Cite. Notre Dame reopened in December 2024. Entry is free but reserve a timed slot to skip the queue.

segments.title: Sunset in Montmartre
segments.info: Have your last Paris dinner up here

commute.summary: Take the metro up the hill

segments.detail: Take the metro up to Montmartre for Sacre Coeur, which is free, and the street artists on Place du Tertre. Have a terrace dinner with city views at dusk, around 45 to 65 euros.

pin.name: Basilique du Sacre Coeur
pin.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris, France

days.label: The long travel day to Buxton

segments.title: Eurostar back to London
segments.info: Coach 13, seat 24, be there by 5:30am
segments.detail: About two and a quarter hours direct to St Pancras, arriving around 8:30am London time (Paris is an hour ahead). Get to Gare du Nord by 5:30am, about 90 minutes ahead: as an Australian (non-EU) passport holder you may need to register fingerprints and a photo at an EES border terminal before check in, which adds time. Ticket checks close 30 minutes before departure. Complete your Eurostar advance passenger information beforehand. This is the most time critical moment of the trip, so do not cut it fine. The hotel is an eight minute walk from the station.

segments.title: Walk to Euston
segments.info: About a 15 minute walk
segments.detail: You arrive into St Pancras at 8:30am. Euston is a 12 to 15 minute walk away. You have a big buffer before the 1:13pm train, so have a proper sit down breakfast. No need to rush.

segments.title: Train to Manchester
segments.info: Coach E, seat 33, catch the 1:13pm exactly
segments.detail: Just over two hours direct to Manchester Piccadilly. This is an advance single tied to this exact 1:13pm train, so you must be on it; miss it and you would need a new full price ticket. Your Eurostar gets you to London by 8:30am, leaving a large buffer, so even a delayed Eurostar should not threaten this connection. It cost 43 pounds 50.

segments.title: Train to Buxton
segments.info: Buy on the day, about 5 to 8 pounds
segments.detail: Your Avanti gets in at 15:19. Trains to Buxton run roughly hourly and take about an hour, so the 15:49 (arriving Buxton 16:51) is the natural connection, with a 30 minute buffer to change platforms. The 16:49 is the backup. Buy at the station machine or in the Northern app, since there is no advance discount. Tap contactless.

segments.title: Check in to the Buxton apartment
segments.info: Cosy 1-bed apartment, staying with a friend

commute.summary: About a 10 minute walk from Buxton station, roughly 550 yards

segments.detail: Cosy 1 bed apartment at flat 1, 5 Eagle Parade, right on the Market Place in central Buxton. From the station, exit onto Station Road, head up towards the centre and Eagle Parade is on the Market Place, about a 10 minute walk. There is a Sainsbury's Local on Eagle Parade itself for anything you need. Confirm key pickup and check-in details with the host and your friend. Then settle in, wander the Pavilion Gardens, have a low key dinner and an early night before the wedding.

pin.name: 5 Eagle Parade, Buxton
pin.address: Flat 1, 5 Eagle Parade, Buxton SK17 6EQ, UK

segments.title: Morning in Buxton
segments.info: Coffee and a slow stroll
segments.detail: Explore the spa town. The Pavilion Gardens and the restored Crescent are both worth a stroll.

pin.name: Buxton Pavilion Gardens
pin.address: St John's Rd, Buxton SK17 6BE, UK

segments.title: The wedding
segments.info: Smart formal, bring a light jacket
segments.detail: Confirm the exact time and venue with the couple. The dress code is smart formal, and a UK July can turn, so pack a light jacket and maybe waterproof shoes.

segments.title: Train to Manchester
segments.info: Sunday service, buy on the day

commute.summary: About a 10 minute walk from the apartment back to Buxton station

segments.detail: Important: the Sunday timetable is sparser than weekdays. The first useful train is the 08:55, arriving Manchester Piccadilly at 09:55 (next one 10:57). Walk the 10 minutes from Eagle Parade back to the station, allow time to buy at the machine, and check National Rail the night before for any Sunday engineering changes. This leg is buy-on-the-day with no advance discount.

segments.title: Train to London
segments.info: London Northwestern only, not Avanti
segments.detail: Your flexible single is valid all day Sunday, so take an LNR (or connecting) service after the 09:55 arrival; departures run frequently and take about two and a quarter hours via Milton Keynes, reaching Euston around 12:30. Confirm the exact departure on the board, since it is not Avanti-valid: look for London Northwestern services. It cost 42 pounds 90. With the 18:30 flight you have a generous buffer even if the morning slips.

segments.title: Head to Heathrow
segments.info: Tube to Terminal 3, about an hour
segments.detail: You arrive into Euston. For Heathrow, the simplest step-free-ish option is the Victoria line to Green Park then the Piccadilly line direct to Terminal 3 (about an hour). Alternatively, hop one stop to Paddington and take the Elizabeth line to Terminal 3 (about 30 minutes). Aim to reach Heathrow by 2 to 2:30pm, a comfortable buffer before the flight.

segments.title: Fly home
segments.info: Ref EAU2YY, be there by 3:30pm
segments.detail: Virgin Atlantic VS41, just under 11 hours direct back to San Francisco in economy, arriving the same day at 9:25pm local time. Be at Terminal 3 about three hours before, so by 3:30pm. Have whatever document you need for US re-entry ready (visa, ESTA, or residency card, depending on your status) since you are travelling on an Australian passport.
